select p.id , p.slug , p.title , p.summary , p.view_count , p.published_at , p.thumbnail_key , p.thumbnail_metadata , p.comment_count , t.name as tag_name from ( select a.id , a.slug , a.title , a.summary , a.view_count , a.published_at , c.key as thumbnail_key , c.metadata as thumbnail_metadata , (select count(*) from comments where post_id = a.id and deleted_at is null) as comment_count from posts a left join attachments b on b.record_id = text(a.id) and b.record_type = 'post' and b.name = 'thumbnail' left join blobs c on c.id = b.blob_id where a.post_type = #{postType} and a.is_published_yn = 'Y' and not exists ( select 1 from series_posts sp inner join series s on s.id = sp.series_id where sp.post_id = a.id and s.slug = 'game-series' )
order by a.view_count ${sortDir}, a.published_at desc
order by a.published_at ${sortDir}
order by a.published_at desc
limit #{limit} offset #{offset} ) p left join post_tags pt on pt.post_id = p.id left join tags t on t.id = pt.tag_id
order by p.view_count ${sortDir}, p.published_at desc
order by p.published_at ${sortDir}
order by p.published_at desc

select count(*) from posts a where a.post_type = #{postType} and a.is_published_yn = 'Y' and not exists ( select 1 from series_posts sp inner join series s on s.id = sp.series_id where sp.post_id = a.id and s.slug = 'game-series' )

select p.id , p.slug , p.title , p.summary , p.content , p.view_count , p.published_at , p.thumbnail_key , p.thumbnail_metadata , p.comment_count , t.name as tag_name from ( select a.id , a.slug , a.title , a.summary , a.content , a.view_count , a.published_at , c.key as thumbnail_key , c.metadata as thumbnail_metadata , (select count(*) from comments where post_id = a.id and deleted_at is null) as comment_count from posts a left join attachments b on b.record_id = text(a.id) and b.record_type = 'post' and b.name = 'thumbnail' left join blobs c on c.id = b.blob_id where a.slug = #{slug} and a.post_type = #{postType} and a.is_published_yn = 'Y' ) p left join post_tags pt on pt.post_id = p.id left join tags t on t.id = pt.tag_id

select a.id , a.slug , a.title , a.summary , a.view_count as viewCount , a.published_at as publishedAt , c.key as thumbnailKey , c.metadata as thumbnailMetadata , (select count(*) from comments where post_id = a.id and deleted_at is null) as commentCount from posts a left join attachments b on b.record_id = text(a.id) and b.record_type = 'post' and b.name = 'thumbnail' left join blobs c on c.id = b.blob_id where a.post_type = #{postType} and a.is_published_yn = 'Y' order by a.published_at desc limit 1

select p.id , p.slug , p.title , p.summary , p.content , p.post_type , p.is_published_yn , p.view_count , p.published_at , p.created_at , b.key as thumbnail_key , b.metadata as thumbnail_metadata , (select string_agg(t.name, ',') from tags t inner join post_tags pt on pt.tag_id = t.id where pt.post_id = p.id) as tags from posts p left join attachments a on a.record_id = p.id::text and a.record_type = 'post' and a.name = 'thumbnail' left join blobs b on b.id = a.blob_id where p.id = #{id}
